monument.A1: Fresh off the factory floor, you're ready to do some damage to yourself. Make your engineers proud.
monument.B1: Battery 1 is fitted. The skybridge was built for shoppers who never came; staff watch you dash into a colleague.
monument.C1: The LED drum lights each bend. Step off the high road onto a car: gravity is company policy.
monument.C2: The road runs through the portal tower at the sixth floor. Take your write-off up there; ignore the view.
monument.B2: The plaque reads ZERO ACCIDENTS: a target, not a record. Stand near it until a colleague finds you.
monument.A2: The neon shops sell nothing, but the traffic reads them. Hands 1 is fitted: bait a colleague with a cone.
monument.A3: The stacked cubes rose one budget at a time. Build the same way: one hit, then another, quickly.
monument.B3: Two screens advertise to each other all night. Legs 1 is fitted: jump into a car between them.
monument.C3: The gateway thanked the car that wrote you off for driving safely. Let one colleague throw you into the next.

parkland.C1: The lantern, the Expo's first exhibit, is lit for clients. With Arms 1, push off one car into the next.
parkland.C2: Our board watches opening day from these terraces. A van delivers the catering; arrange for it to deliver you.
parkland.C3: The arch is the Expo's gate; visitors circle the roundabout once. You go faster: chain hits before each is forgotten.
parkland.B3: The obelisk marks the surveyors' first stake. Police escort a school party here on opening day; test them first.
parkland.A3: A wedding faces the traffic from the belvedere. Legs 2 is fitted: jump into a car, so no guest does.
parkland.A2: The dome is the Expo's showroom; you are the exhibit. Hands 2 is fitted: bait a car with a cone.
parkland.A1: The gardener's pools need cars that stop. Teach them with Arms 2: push off one car into the next.
parkland.B1: The cascade was built to drown out the traffic. The traffic got louder; take your hit up on the highway.
parkland.B2: The board watches the ring over the pools. Battery 2 is fitted: chain your hits.

waterfront.A1: The bus carries engineers through the west portal to the bridge. It never misses; take its hit.
waterfront.B1: Cars go into the tunnel under the hill, and data comes back. Legs 3 is fitted: leap into one.
waterfront.C1: The east portal faces away from its twin. Police here check papers; your Certification needs their fleet on record.
waterfront.C2: The east beach terrace served tourists, then sensors. Drop from its rail onto a car; ships wait for the Certified.
waterfront.C3: The pier tower logs all that floats: containers, ducks, one dummy. Be thrown into a car to earn your entry.
waterfront.B3: The stilt houses keep Chassis 0 behind glass. Arms 3 is fitted; push off a car and show it progress.
waterfront.A3: The west tower keeps the customs log. Your entry reads PURPOSE DESTRUCTION: honour it on the raised road.
waterfront.A2: Sand from three provinces lies under the west beach terrace. Place a cone; one more clean reading before the ceremony.
waterfront.B2: The circus monument, cast from your written-off chassis, reads ZERO ACCIDENTS (EXCLUDING TESTS). Battery 3 is fitted; chain your hits.

acts.monument: Dummy Corporation welcomes you off the factory floor. The cars are your colleagues; Certification is your goal.
acts.parkland: The Expo opens to clients when this park passes. Your training keeps them safe.
acts.waterfront: Certified dummies ship across the river, to be sacrificed in service to our clients. Your papers are being prepared.

any.label: ANY WRITE-OFF
any.brief: Walk into the path of the incoming vehicles. Time your approach, and choose your angle carefully. Bonus points for combinations and lethal hits.

dash.label: DASH INTO A CAR
dash.brief: Dash into a car. The final hit must be the dash.

drop.label: DROP ONTO A CAR
drop.brief: Drop onto a car from above. The final hit must be that drop.

jump.label: JUMP INTO A CAR
jump.brief: Jump into a car. The jump must be the final hit.

level.label: ON A RAISED ROAD
level.brief: Climb to a raised road. The final hit must land up there, not on the street.

cone.label: CONE-BAITED CAR
cone.brief: Place a cone. The final hit must come from a car reacting to it.

push.label: PUSH OFF A CAR
push.brief: Push off one car. The final hit must be the next car.

bounce.label: THROWN INTO A CAR
bounce.brief: Let one car throw you into another. Take the final hit while a hit is still throwing you.

struck.label: STRUCK, NOT DASHING
struck.brief: Walk or stand in the traffic. A car must deliver the final hit while you are not dashing.

combo.label: COMBO ×{n}
combo.brief: Chain your hits into a combo. The final hit must be link {n} or later.

cls.label: A {cls}
cls.brief: Step in front of the {clsLong}. The final hit must come from a {cls}.

ending: Your model has passed and will be manufactured for our clients. A Corporation drone carries you to the ship.

notices.n01: You are a Dummy Corporation trainee. Every write-off brings Certification closer.
notices.n02: Welcome, trainee. Every write-off brings Certification closer.
notices.n03: Get your Dummy Certification in Shenzhen Smart City and learn about the Corporation.
notices.n13: A Corporation drone brings this part.
notices.n14: A Corporation drone brings this part. Keep training.
notices.n15: A Corporation drone brings that part
notices.n17: Corporation drone dispatched: chassis in the river
notices.n18: Corporation drone dispatched. Obstruction will be relocated.
notices.n19: Corporation drone: chassis recovered from the river
notices.n20: Training complete. The Corporation thanks you for your service.
notices.n21: Traffic exhausted. Training incomplete; report to the bay.
notices.n24: Neon shops, LED walls; one road splits round the monument under the walkway ring. Your training begins here.
notices.n25: Water and concrete; a boulevard passes under the raised ring. Your write-offs open the Expo to clients.
notices.n26: A hill walled by towers; bridges cross the drive and the river. Certified dummies ship across it to clients.
notices.n28: Towers and barriers. Corporation Tower stands over your training.
notices.n29: The test centre the city was modelled on. Hits on its impact plates count for more.
notices.n30: Two flyovers cross it, one above the other. Corporation Tower stands at the centre; towers shade your training.
notices.n31: Impact plates mark the road at the centre. A write-off on a plate counts for more.
notices.n34: Get hit in fun, creative, and destructive ways before the vehicles run out.
notices.n36: Self-driving cars are designed never to hit anyone. Your training: get hit, in combos, and earn your parts.
notices.n37: Write off bodies; every {Q} write-offs, the grade rises. Keep training until the vehicles run out.

b013.text: OI! Right in the grille, kind regards.

b034.text: A write-off on my record. Unthinkable.

b052.text: Too slow, ha! Have a nice day!

b061.text: It lunged and nothing happened. Same.

b081.text: Move. I have a schedule, and standards.

c024.text: Hit on campus. That goes on my record.
